description: The chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models with different training objectives. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories, listed in the order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family category is represented by a group of six bars, corresponding to the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in distinct shades. The bars for each model are accompanied by error bars indicating the range of values. The values for the "effect" range from approximately 0.5 for Isolate-mBERT-L2 to around 20 for IE-Indic-XLM-B2, with the highest values generally observed for the B2 models across most language families, and the lowest values for the L2 and R2 models, particularly for the Isolate family. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
